=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2501-2539 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The retry PR read builds its `--jq '[... (.mergeable_state // ""), (.base.ref // "")] | @tsv'` output with empty fields, and `IFS=$'\t' read` merges the adjacent tabs, so when mergeable_state is null `.base.ref` (e.g. `main`) shifts into `_rb_retry_mergeable_state`, and the guard JSON at 2535-2536 then carries `mergeable_state: "main"`.
  WHY: `"main"` passes the guard's `^[a-z_]+$` filter and reaches the `*)` arm of _pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh), which returns 0, so the direct admin `gh pr merge --match-head-commit` runs without the guard (the bypass this PR exists to stop); severities differ (minimax BLOCKER; sonnet, luna, glm MAJOR), so the highest is used; fix is `(.mergeable_state // "none")` / `(.base.ref // "-")` plus updating the pinned jq string in tests/test_review_rb_judge_head_binding.py.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3325-3339 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the `merge_with_followup` sync merge, if the outer guard passes but the per-attempt guard inside `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient` (line 2538) defers, control falls into the `else` branch and writes `judge_skip_reason=sync_merge_failed` instead of `mergeability_pending`, because this path has no `elif [ "${RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED:-false}" = "true" ]` arm (the chains at 2656-2660 and 2763-2767 have one).
  WHY: A deferral is reported as a hard merge failure: a stale RB_JUDGE_MERGE_ERROR is printed, review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:63-65 posts a "merge manually" comment, and this contradicts the agents.d contract "Deferrals reuse existing outcomes"; no test covers the outer-guard-passes, retry-guard-defers case.
- scripts/ci_final_status.sh:100-108 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `ci/final` status POST goes through `gh_retry` without `--idempotent` or `GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true`, so gh_helpers.sh:2151-2156 sets `max_attempts=1` and the POST is tried exactly once.
  WHY: One transient 5xx or connection reset logs `outcome=post_failed` and leaves the head without the required `ci/final`; nothing recovers it automatically (`final-ci-failed` fires only when `lint` fails, and `_pr_ensure_final_ci` does not re-dispatch after a completed run), so the PR stays blocked until a human acts; a status POST is idempotent, so retrying is safe.
- scripts/ci_final_status.sh:75-77, 100-108 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the status POST fails, the script exits without writing anything, so an earlier `ci/final=success` on the same SHA stays the newest status for that context.
  WHY: A rerun on the same SHA whose CI fails and whose failure POST also fails leaves the old success satisfying the ruleset, so auto-merge stays eligible despite red CI (a false green); the script's "missing status keeps the PR blocked" claim holds only on the first run for a SHA.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:5021-5046 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The status step checks out scripts/ci_final_status.sh from `ref: ${{ github.sha }}` (the PR head) and runs it with a `statuses: write` token, so a PR can rewrite the script to post `ci/final=success` regardless of the aggregate result, or skip the POST.
  WHY: Once owner step O2 makes the ruleset require `ci/final` (especially the un-pinned variant), the PR-controlled script becomes the only source of the required status; severities differ (minimax and luna MAJOR, glm NIT), so the highest is used; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this item, because the dispatched run already executes the PR's own ci.yml and issue #9939 accepts "the same trust as today's `lint` check-run".
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2616-2617 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard "${pr}"` inside _orch_squash_merge_bound receives only the PR number, so every direct-fallback attempt makes an extra `GET repos/<repo>/pulls/<n>` even though the callers already hold the PR JSON.
  WHY: This is not a functional failure; it is one avoidable REST GET per fallback, against the issue's §15 "reuse the PR JSON each path already holds" constraint; sonnet notes a fresh read is arguably safer; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Goal 2: "No pipeline merge path merges a PR GitHub reports as `mergeable_state: blocked`."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml line 2207 (`elif gh pr merge "${report_pr_number}" --squash --match-head-commit "${report_head_sha}"; then`); also .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml line 1340 (per anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The guard was added only to scripts/review_rb_judge.sh and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (the sites in the issue's Context), no hunk touches workflow-log-analysis.yml, so its direct merge at line 2207 stays unguarded, the update_workflows.yml:1340 direct fallback is also unguarded (sonnet), the site is outside the plan's files_touched grant (sonnet, minimax, glm), luna and minimax say the merge can run with the admin `GH_PAT`, while glm says it runs with `github.token` so GitHub refuses a blocked merge, and glm reports that a grep shows line 2207 is the only remaining unguarded direct `gh pr merge --squash`.
- requirement: "Deferrals reuse existing outcomes (`RB_MERGE_STATUS=mergeability_pending`, `judge_skip_reason=mergeability_pending`, …)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, the sync-merge failure branch in `RB_ACTION=merge_with_followup`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: When the outer guard passes but the guard in `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient` defers, the branch falls through to `else` and emits `judge_skip_reason=sync_merge_failed`; it lacks the deferral handling the other guarded judge paths have.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:lines 3325-3339 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In the merge_with_followup sync merge, the outer guard passes, the direct merge hits a transient 5xx, and the guard inside `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient` (2538) then defers with RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED=true; this path has no `elif` for that case (unlike 2657-2660 and 2764-2767), so control falls into `else`.
  WHY: The deferral is reported as `judge_skip_reason=sync_merge_failed` with a stale RB_JUDGE_MERGE_ERROR, review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:63-65 posts "merge manually", and review_autofix.yml:5945 sends a manual-merge message; no test covers this case; fix is a ~4-line `elif` that writes `mergeability_pending`.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:lines 2501-2503 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Tab IFS merges the empty `.mergeable_state` field, so the base ref shifts into `_rb_retry_mergeable_state` and the guard JSON at 2535-2536 gets `mergeable_state: "main"`, which hits the `*)` arm and returns 0.
  WHY: A null mergeable_state skips the defer rule and the direct admin merge at 2539 runs unguarded (REST usually sends "unknown" instead of null); fix: `(.mergeable_state // "none")`, `(.base.ref // "-")`, and update the pinned jq in tests/test_review_rb_judge_head_binding.py.
- scripts/ci_final_status.sh:lines 100-104 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: gh_retry (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2151-2156; _gh_api_args_unsafe_post 1696-1716) gives this non-idempotent POST a single attempt.
  WHY: One transient failure leaves the head without `ci/final`, and nothing re-dispatches or fires `final-ci-failed`, so the PR stays blocked; fix: prefix the call with `GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 2616-2617 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The guard receives the PR number, so it makes one extra GET per direct fallback although callers hold the PR JSON (e.g. `_rtm_pr_json` ~33657, `_rb_pr_json` ~33972).
  WHY: Not functional; it violates the §15 reuse constraint, and a fresh read is arguably safer.
- Not flagged (explicitly rejected): the claim that a PR can rewrite scripts/ci_final_status.sh to post a fake `ci/final=success`; the PR already controls ci.yml, and issue #9939 accepts this risk.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  Requirement: Goal 2: "No pipeline merge path merges a PR GitHub reports as `mergeable_state: blocked`."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml line 2207 and .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml line 1340
  Evidence of absence: The guard is only in review_rb_judge.sh and orchestrate_poll_process.sh; both sites above are unguarded and outside files_touched, so this may belong in a follow-up.
- Hardening suggestions (3 related items): the GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT prefix at ci_final_status.sh:100, the jq placeholders at review_rb_judge.sh:2501, and the deferred `elif` at review_rb_judge.sh:3334-3335; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
